showcase.title: Image Splicing for visual composition workflows
showcase.subtitle: Combine multiple images into stitched, grid, or bento layouts with advanced styling and export controls.

tips.sync: Your active preset auto-syncs layout, style, and export changes after a short debounce.
tips.preview: Lower preview quality when working with many high-resolution images to reduce RAM and CPU pressure.
tips.export: You can export as a single combined image, split outputs per row or per column, then download as ZIP or PDF.
tips.import: Import is flexible: drag and drop, file picker, and clipboard paste are all supported.

faqs.q1: What is Image Splicing best for?
faqs.a1: It is ideal for combining multiple images into one structured composition, such as long vertical strips, visual boards, social-ready grids, and bento-style layouts.
faqs.q2: How does preset behavior work in this tool?
faqs.a2: Each preset stores complete layout, visual styling, and export configuration. While you edit in workspace mode, changes are auto-synced back to the active preset.
faqs.q3: Why does the app warn before large one-by-one downloads?
faqs.a3: One-by-one export can trigger many browser download events. The confirmation step is a safety guard to prevent accidental heavy download bursts.
faqs.q4: Can I export to PDF as well as image formats?
faqs.a4: Yes. You can export as merged PDF or individual PDFs, in addition to image outputs and ZIP packaging.
faqs.q5: Which layout presets are supported out of the box?
faqs.a5: The tool supports Stitch Vertical, Stitch Horizontal, Grid, and Bento presets. Each preset changes how rows/columns are formed and how images flow inside each group.
faqs.q6: What does Flow Split Overflow do in Bento mode?
faqs.a6: When enabled, oversized items can be split across flow boundaries instead of forcing a hard wrap. This helps keep group sizing more balanced in constrained layouts.
faqs.q7: What is the difference between per-row and per-col export?
faqs.a7: Per-row exports one file per horizontal group, while per-col exports one file per vertical group. It is useful when you want modular outputs instead of one merged canvas.
faqs.q8: When should I enable Trim Background?
faqs.a8: Enable Trim Background when exporting grouped outputs to reduce extra empty padding around each exported segment. Keep it off if you need consistent outer canvas margins.
faqs.q9: Does Preview Quality affect final export quality?
faqs.a9: No. Preview Quality only controls rendering load in the editor for smoother interaction. Final export still uses your export format, codec settings, and target quality.
